description: Conformance cases for loopback data endpoints (pkg/ext-go/engine/endpoint). Every case names an endpoint and a policy; 'check' is the outcome of endpoint.check (the shape rules alone) and 'validate' of endpoint.validate (the shape rules and the policy). Outcomes: ok, invalid, denied, expired. A binding passes when it reproduces every outcome. The policy's now is fixed so the cases do not age.
